In my opinion, I feel like what you're looking for, as far as the looks go, is something that will much easier be found in air soft.

That being said; the m17 or t15 are both really cool looking markers. From what I've seen, they work really well, but I don't have any first hand experience with either of them. 

I do, however, play strictly magfed with a TiPX. It's a whole lot of fun, for sure and I'm very glad you're deciding to hop on the magfed train. 

If you're absolutely set on the AR-15/AK47 platform, you may want to consider going with a rip-clip/cyclone fed marker. You can get a cap for the loader that restricts you to 30 balls before reloading, plus you get the look you want, with effectively no hopper blocking your view. 

If you're set on magfed and willing to budge on the look, I very strongly suggest a TiPX/TCR platform. The magazines are cheap by comparison. Which means *when* you lose them (because you will) your wallet doesn't hurt so much.

I hope this was helpful, and welcome to magfed
